result.title: NeoWorld-3: From Pixels to Code-Defined Physical Worlds
result.summary: Simulation-ready world reconstruction demands physical interactivity beyond visual realism, which existing black-box 3D generation fails to deliver. We present NeoWorld-3, a coding-agent framework that reconstructs interactive 3D worlds from visual observations via tunable, executable programs. At its core, NeoSDK provides the underlying computational engine for low-level geometries, part composition, differentiable parameter refinement, and physics validation. At the same time, NeoMCP exposes these capabilities as structured, tool-callable APIs for vision-language agents to visually inspect, edit code, and iteratively refine programs. Through a hierarchical coordinator-worker architecture, the framework scales seamlessly from standalone articulated objects to complex compositional scenes. Evaluations across object-level and scene-level reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that NeoWorld-3 achieves state-of-the-art geometric fidelity and physical readiness. Crucially, manipulation trajectories planned within our reconstructed twins achieve successful zero-shot execution on a physical dual-arm robot, completing the Real-Sim-Real loop.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NeoWorld-3 编码智能体框架，借助 NeoSDK 的几何、可微参数优化与物理校验能力，并通过 NeoMCP 向 VLM 代理暴露工具接口，使其从视觉观察迭代编写和修改程序，重建可交互的 3D 世界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉检查—改代码—再验证」的代理迭代回路，可能为 LVR 中依据视觉证据更新推理状态与何时停止提供概念参照，但研究对象是世界重建而非 latent 推理，联系较远，仅供核查。
